# Sources

Copied from https://github.com/yama6a/subtitle-toolbox-php/tree/c0adecd5375820d5313f1583fc7e67942d514600/tests/files/csv, MIT. In the rows below, "this repository" means subtitle-toolbox-php.

| File | Source | License |
|:--- |:--- |:--- |
| `own_frame_times.csv` | Written for this repository. A header row, CR LF line endings, and start and end times in hh:mm:ss:ff, as broadcast caption tools export them | MIT |
| `own_junk_before_header.csv` | Written for this repository. An export note, an empty `;;;` row and a project row before the header, `;` delimiter | MIT |
| `own_unclosed_quote.csv` | Written for this repository. A quoted cell without a closing quote in the first data row | MIT |
| `own_role_names_length_column.csv` | Written for this repository. The `start`, `end` and `text` headers and an extra `Length` column with the text length | MIT |
| `own_role_names_name_column.csv` | Written for this repository. The `start`, `end` and `text` headers and an extra `name` column | MIT |
| `own_role_names_out_column.csv` | Written for this repository. The `start` and `text` headers, no end column, and an extra `out` column with `yes` and `no` | MIT |
